name: Tadka dal
steps: Boil dal with turmeric until soft.
Heat ghee, add cumin, garlic and red chilli.
Pour the tadka over the dal.
Garnish with coriander.
story: Smoky cumin and chilli bloomed in hot ghee, poured over soft dal. The sound of the sizzle is half the memory.

name: Peanut tempered rice
steps: Heat oil, crackle mustard seeds.
Fry peanuts, curry leaves, green chilli and onion.
Mix in cooked rice and salt.
story: Leftover rice turned into something crunchy and bright with a mustard-seed tempering.

name: Lemon rice
steps: Temper mustard seeds, peanuts and curry leaves in oil.
Add turmeric and cooked rice.
Finish with lemon juice.
story: A sunny, tangy rice that travels well and tastes like a long train ride.

name: Coriander potato curd bowl
steps: Mash boiled potatoes lightly.
Whisk in curd, grated ginger and cumin.
Top with coriander and green chilli.
story: Cool curd, warm cumin and a handful of coriander that was about to go bad.

name: Jeera aloo
steps: Heat oil, add cumin.
Add potato, turmeric and red chilli; cook until golden.
Finish with coriander.
story: Golden potatoes with toasted cumin. Simple, honest, always there.

name: Palak sabzi
steps: Saute cumin, garlic and onion in oil.
Add tomato, then spinach.
Cook until wilted.
story: Half a packet of spinach, saved from the fridge and turned into dinner.

name: Tomato rasam
steps: Simmer tomato with tamarind.
Crush pepper, cumin and garlic; add.
Temper with hing and curry leaves.
story: Peppery, tangy and thin. Medicine and comfort in one cup.

name: Mint chutney
steps: Blend everything with a little water.
Adjust lemon and salt.
story: Fresh, sharp and green. It lifts every plate it touches.

name: Curd rice
steps: Mix cooked rice with curd.
Temper mustard seeds and curry leaves; stir in grated ginger.
story: Cooling, gentle and tangy. The last course of a South Indian meal.

name: Spinach dal
steps: Boil dal until soft.
Add chopped spinach and cook 3 minutes.
Temper cumin and garlic in ghee; pour over.
story: Green and earthy, with a tempering poured over at the last second.

name: 20-Min One-Pot Dal
steps: Pressure cook dal with turmeric.
Fry cumin, garlic and chilli in butter.
Stir in and serve.
note: Swapped ghee for salted butter. Fast, nutty and comforting.
story: Swapped ghee for salted butter. Fast, nutty and comforting.

name: Coconut & Black Mustard Dal
steps: Simmer dal with turmeric and coconut.
Crackle mustard seeds, curry leaves and chilli in oil.
Pour over.
note: Coastal Kerala twist: coconut for creaminess, mustard seeds for sharpness.
story: Coastal Kerala twist: coconut for creaminess, mustard seeds for sharpness.

name: Smoked Paprika Lentil Soup
steps: Soften onion and garlic.
Add dal and water; simmer until soft.
Finish with cumin and chilli.
note: Madrid kitchen version: smoky chilli stands in for the original ember heat.
story: Madrid kitchen version: smoky chilli stands in for the original ember heat.

name: Grandmother-style leftover dal
steps: Warm the leftover dal.
Smoke mustard oil, add garlic, cumin and chilli.
Pour over.
note: Smoky, sharp aroma from mustard oil.
story: Smoky, sharp aroma from mustard oil.

name: Hostel peanut rice
steps: Fry peanuts and onion in oil.
Toss in leftover rice with salt.
note: Crunchy and nutty. Ready in 10 minutes.
story: Crunchy and nutty. Ready in 10 minutes.
